sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Dino Dash are centered around the player's ability to control the baby dinosaur as it navigates through different environments. The player can move the dinosaur left and right using the keyboard, mouse, or touch controls. The game also features a simple jump mechanic that allows the player to jump over obstacles and reach higher platforms.

As the player progresses through levels, they will encounter a variety of obstacles, including predators, pitfalls, and obstacles that block their path. The player will need to use their reflexes and quick thinking to avoid these obstacles and reach the end of each level. The game also features a power-up system that allows the player to collect power-ups to boost their speed, jump higher, and become invincible for a short period.

One of the core mechanics of the game is the ability to collect coins and score points. The player can collect coins by jumping on top of them or by collecting power-ups that give them a temporary boost in score. The game also features a high score system that allows players to compete with others to achieve the highest score.
